ui.chat.dialogs.archive_action.note: Confirms hiding the conversation from lists; Undo is available afterwards. maxCells is an advisory translator target, not measured fit.

ui.chat.dialogs.cancel.role: safe dismissal button in archive/delete confirmations
ui.chat.dialogs.cancel.note: Safe default-focus action. Dismisses without changing or deleting the conversation. maxCells is an advisory translator target, not measured fit.

ui.chat.dialogs.delete_action.note: Danger action; permanently removes this conversation, unlike archive. maxCells is an advisory translator target, not measured fit.

ui.chat.dialogs.delete_title.note: Shown above the named consequence message; question mark is part of the heading. maxCells is an advisory translator target, not measured fit.

ui.chat.dialogs.options.clear_confirm.role: confirm button in the clear-conversation dialog
ui.chat.dialogs.options.clear_confirm.note: Performs the deletion. The cancel button uses the shared Cancel action.

ui.chat.dialogs.options.clear_conversati.role: destructive action in the chat options sheet
ui.chat.dialogs.options.clear_conversati.note: Opens the confirmation dialog; it does not delete anything by itself.

ui.chat.dialogs.options.clear_message.note: States the scope (every message in THIS conversation), that the deletion is local, and that there is no undo. Must not imply the agent itself is deleted.

ui.chat.dialogs.options.clear_title.tone: question, sentence case, trailing question mark
ui.chat.dialogs.options.clear_title.note: The dialog that guards deleting this conversation's messages.

ui.chat.dialogs.options.description.role: subtitle of the chat options sheet
ui.chat.dialogs.options.description.tone: verb phrase, sentence case, no trailing punctuation
ui.chat.dialogs.options.description.note: Says whose settings the sheet edits: the agent behind this conversation.

ui.chat.dialogs.options.title.role: title of the chat options sheet
ui.chat.dialogs.options.title.note: A settings sheet about the conversation's agent, opened from the chat header.

ui.chat.dialogs.make_temporary_title.note: Asks before scheduling a deletion of an existing chat.

ui.chat.dialogs.make_temporary_deleted.role: confirmation dialog body, what is deleted
ui.chat.dialogs.make_temporary_deleted.note: 30 min is the backend default idle window.

ui.chat.dialogs.make_temporary_kept.role: confirmation dialog body, what is kept
ui.chat.dialogs.make_temporary_kept.note: Files on the computer are never deleted by this.

ui.chat.dialogs.keep_and_link.note: Keeps the temporary chat, then links it to the project.

ui.chat.dialogs.keep_and_pin.note: Keeps the temporary chat, then pins it.
